us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Midterm campaign enters final weekend as early voting nears 50 million
bullets: Trump rallied Republicans in Florida before planned Iowa and Kansas stops.
Bill Clinton campaigned for Democrats in Mississippi.
Reuters reported early ballots approached a midterm record near 50 million.

articles.title: Federal judge opens ethics inquiry into Trump attorneys in DC golf-course dispute
bullets: Judge Ana Reyes said she would open a formal inquiry.
The dispute involves a planned Trump-backed golf-course project in Washington.
The case is one of two shaping federal plans for DC land.

articles.title: Judge delays ruling in Comey case as prosecutors seek new indictment
bullets: A federal judge postponed a dismissal decision Friday.
Prosecutors are pursuing an indictment over a decade-old media leak allegation.
The case involves former FBI Director James Comey.

articles.title: US jobless claims fall to lowest level since mid-July
bullets: Initial unemployment claims dropped to 194,000.
AP said layoffs remain low across the labor market.
October hiring data is due the following Friday.

articles.title: AP previews Virginia election-counting expectations before Election Day
bullets: AP published decision notes for Virginia races.
The guide explains vote-counting and reporting patterns.
Virginia is among states watched closely in the midterms.

articles.title: G20 foreign ministers in Atlanta set to end meeting without consensus
bullets: AP said security divisions overshadowed the talks.
Russia’s war in Ukraine remained a major sticking point.
Foreign ministers met for two days in Atlanta.

articles.title: King Charles urges countries to follow Guyana’s forest-protection example
bullets: Charles visited Guyana and praised its conservation record.
He warned deforestation threatens health and future generations.
The remarks came during a South American visit.

articles.title: US approves $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
bullets: Reuters reported the approval on October 31.
The sale would strengthen Ukraine’s air defenses.
The decision comes amid continued war-related diplomacy.

articles.title: Congo Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 5,000
bullets: Reuters reported the outbreak has killed more than 5,000 people.
The update appeared in October 31 global coverage.
Ebola remains a major public-health emergency in Congo.

articles.title: Russia accused of forcing closure of Novaya Gazeta
bullets: Al Jazeera and other outlets reported the closure claim.
Novaya Gazeta is a prominent Russian investigative newspaper.
The story was among widely reported global headlines Saturday.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories and India-linked developments

articles.title: Tanker carrying 27 Indians reportedly attacked with limpet mines in Strait of Hormuz
bullets: NDTV and other outlets reported the tanker attack.
The vessel was carrying 27 Indian nationals.
The incident occurred in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: India launches next-generation navigation satellite to strengthen NavIC
bullets: ISRO launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite from Sriharikota.
Coverage said the launch restored NavIC standalone operational status.
The mission advances India’s indigenous positioning network.

articles.title: Indian regulators order Sun Pharma to halt eye-care drug production
bullets: Reuters reported regulators found quality lapses.
The order affects production at one Sun Pharma plant.
The action concerns an eye-care drug.

articles.title: India forms high-level committee to recommend banking reforms
bullets: Reuters reported the committee’s formation.
The panel will recommend reforms for India’s banking sector.
The story appeared in Saturday’s India news digest.

articles.title: Supreme Court seeks Election Commission report on Form 7 misuse charge
bullets: The Hindu reported the Supreme Court’s direction.
The case concerns alleged misuse of Form 7.
The issue relates to voter-list governance.

articles.title: Nasdaq posts worst day since June as AI-spending worries hit tech
bullets: Reuters said the Nasdaq had its biggest decline since June.
The selloff followed pressure on major AI-linked technology stocks.
Investors questioned returns from heavy AI capital spending.

articles.title: Nasdaq 100 faces $2 trillion October wipeout on AI concerns
bullets: Reuters estimated a more than $2 trillion monthly value loss.
Big Tech earnings intensified scrutiny of AI investment returns.
Meta’s planned financing added to dilution concerns.

articles.title: Intel and Reddit slump sharply in end-of-October selloff
bullets: Reuters reported Intel and Reddit each fell 29%.
Sandisk dropped 13% amid AI-capex worries.
Microsoft, Meta, Amazon and Alphabet also declined Friday.

articles.title: Dow falls 572 points as major US indexes close lower
bullets: The Dow fell 572.25 points, or 1.1%.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also ended lower.
AP tied the decline to worsening tech-stock weakness.

articles.title: Markets brace for midterms, jobs data and major earnings
bullets: Reuters said next week will test AI-wary investors.
Apple, AMD and Palantir are among expected reporters.
October jobs data is also due next week.

articles.title: AI earnings season raises investor concern over hyperscaler spending
bullets: Axios said AI earnings highlighted large risks.
The Nasdaq briefly entered correction territory.
October losses reflected concern about AI spending returns.

articles.title: ExxonMobil and Chevron report strong profits amid higher oil prices
bullets: Weekend market coverage highlighted blowout profits from both oil majors.
The reports came as oil prices surged.
Energy earnings contrasted with tech-sector weakness.

articles.title: Atlas Oil accused in court filing of mixing cyanide-releasing compound into gasoline
bullets: The allegation appeared in a US court filing.
Coverage identified Atlas Oil as the fuel trader involved.
The story was listed among October 30 business headlines.

articles.title: Pemex posts $573 million loss despite oil-price surge
bullets: Weekend business coverage reported Pemex’s quarterly loss.
The loss came even as oil prices increased.
Pemex remains under scrutiny over finances.

articles.title: Corporate earnings and employment reports set up busy economic week
bullets: AP said earnings updates will span many industries.
October hiring data will be released next Friday.
Reports will add detail on the economy’s health.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts funding target by $10 billion amid tech selloff
bullets: Reuters, citing the FT, reported OpenAI now seeks about $20 billion.
The reported desired valuation dropped to $1.25 trillion.
AI-stock weakness pressured fundraising plans.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO filing details sweeping AI ambitions and major risks
bullets: AP reported Anthropic filed for a potentially record IPO.
The Claude maker has not yet turned a profit.
Its filing warned of cybersecurity and existential AI risks.

articles.title: Malaysia seizes $12 million in advanced AI chips hidden in servers
bullets: Reuters reported 30 server units were seized at Kuala Lumpur airport.
Officials suspected a smuggling syndicate used false customs declarations.
The servers contained cutting-edge AI chips.

articles.title: China’s export curbs target key AI technologies
bullets: Reuters reported China drew a line around AI crown-jewel technologies.
The curbs were published in late October technology coverage.
The move affects global AI supply-chain strategy.

articles.title: Cybersecurity experts warn of difficult software-flaw wave tied to AI boom
bullets: Axios described October as a chaotic month for AI-related cyber issues.
Researchers said PHP vulnerabilities drew heavy exploitation attempts.
Anthropic’s filing highlighted AI’s growing cyber capabilities.
